actualPromptText:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game sprite sheet, enemy-046-colonial-raider, ATTACK animation
Primary request: create one entirely original fan-made 4 columns by 2 rows sprite sheet containing exactly eight chronological firearm-attack poses of the same Colonial Raider project character. Colonial Raider is a Tantalus project label, not an official Alien faction or canonical uniform; canonExact=false.
Input images, if supplied: prior reviewed 046 boards serve only as identity, outfit, palette, carbine-geometry and physical-scale references. Create eight new firing poses; do not copy, collage or interpolate their pose pixels.
Canvas and backdrop: final raster exactly 1774 pixels wide by 887 pixels high, exact 2:1 landscape. Perfectly flat, perfectly uniform pure RGB #FF00FF chroma-magenta across every background pixel; no floor, shadow, gradient, texture, scenery, border or visible grid.
Identity lock: one unnamed ordinary adult human ambusher with lean realistic proportions. Dusty gray short hooded utility coat; visible eyes and brow above one fixed gray-brown half-face dust respirator with two small filters; sand canvas chest harness; exactly one scratched brown composite shoulder plate on the camera-facing near shoulder; charcoal work trousers; battered dark boots; fingered gloves; compact filter-and-salvage backpack; one muted ochre blank identification tape with no lettering.
Weapon lock: exactly one original compact semi-automatic frontier scavenger carbine in every pose, scratched charcoal steel and muted brown composite furniture, short fixed stock, coherent receiver, simple iron sights, narrow barrel and exactly one straight detachable box magazine. Match Image 1 butt-to-muzzle length and geometry exactly. Complete carbine points RIGHT and stays in the same two hands. It is not an M41A, NSG23, AK, real-world branded rifle, UPP gun, USCMC gun or energy weapon.
Style: match Image 1 polished modern 2D metroidvania sprite art, detailed painted pixel-art feel, crisp readable silhouettes, restrained industrial frontier realism, entirely original project design.
Composition: precise implied 4x2 grid with exactly one complete full-body raider per cell in strict row-major order. Every pose stays centered inside its own implied cell with generous equal gutters. Match Image 1 body height, body mass and carbine length. Leave extra empty margin in front of the muzzle. No limb, hood, coat tail, backpack, muzzle, flash or casing touches or crosses a cell boundary.
Orientation: strict orthographic gameplay side profile facing RIGHT in all eight poses; nose, chest, knees, toes and muzzle point right. Never left-facing, front-facing, rear-facing or three-quarter. No camera rotation or perspective drift.
Palette and materials: match Image 1 dusty gray, sand canvas, brown composite, charcoal cloth, scratched dull metal and tiny muted ochre accent; matte worn surfaces only.
Constraints: exactly one human and one carbine per cell; stable face, eyes, respirator, hood, anatomy, clothing, handedness, shoulder asymmetry, pack and weapon; no duplicate frames; no ejected casing; no text, letters, numbers, logos, insignia, UI, watermark, panel lines, crop, overlap or official/licensed bitmap reuse.
Avoid: canonical-faction claims; official faction equipment; Space Marine, cowboy or spiked wasteland styling; cyber limbs; sealed helmet; second firearm; weapon morphing; automatic burst; giant muzzle flash; aiming toward camera.
Chronology, strict row-major: 1 low ready; 2 stock begins seating into shoulder; 3 muzzle acquires target; 4 stable aim lock; 5 one single semi-automatic shot with only a tiny attached dull-yellow muzzle spark; 6 compact rearward recoil; 7 sights recover and muzzle returns to line; 8 controlled return toward low ready. One shot only, no reload, coherent shoulder and hand mechanics.
